ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level contrast; predominantly low-intensity (black/dark charcoal) pixels accounting for approximately 95% of the surface area, with sparse high-intensity (white) localized clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is solid dark pigmentation. Discrete, small white circular clusters (0.5-1% area) are distributed semi-randomly across both lobes, with a higher concentration of focal spots on the lower-middle quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 40 degrees and a narrow vertex depth relative to the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern. The right lobe exhibits higher amplitude peaks (approx. 5-10 pixels) compared to the left lobe, which shows more moderate, consistent scalloping along its boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trajectory initiating from the median notch, transitioning to a broad convex curve toward the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters (5-12 pixel diameter) scattered across the ventral surface, indicative of sessile organism attachment scars.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular notch/indentation is visible on the outer third of the trailing edge of the right lobe, deeper than surrounding serrations.
other_distinctive_markers: Avian presence; a small bird is perched on the upper trailing edge boundary of the left lobe.
